name: story-mcp
title: MCP story
description: Dot animation of an assistant plugging into the hosted MCP server and answering from the web.
usage: Giving an AI assistant web search through MCP, on a workflow card (the Search page shows it beside RAG). Plays only on screen; shows its resting picture with reduced motion.
avoid: Stories as the main content of a page
notes: An assistant window plugs into a globe through a connector labeled MCP, the prompt "search the web" is typed and sent, a pulse runs along the cable and back, and the reply lines fill in. The labels under the globe name the server and that sign-in uses OAuth.

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
